Wi-Fi Diagnostics

Browser-based network diagnostic — no software installation required

About this diagnostic

  • Runs entirely in your browser — no app or extension needed
  • No special browser permissions required
  • Measures your connection to the local network and the internet
  • Approximate data transferred: ~70 MB (download + upload tests)
Ready to start

Connection Info

Wi-Fi (reported by UniFi)

These values are reported by the wireless infrastructure, not measured by your browser.

Wi-Fi History (last 30 min)

5-minute averages from the UniFi controller.

LAN Performance

Measured between your device and the diagnostic server on your local network.

Throughput

Download and upload speed to the local diagnostic server.

Internet

Latency from your device to the internet. A slow internet result with a healthy LAN result suggests a problem beyond the local network.

Internet Speed

Download and upload speed measured directly from your device to Cloudflare's servers.
